answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available, and they show the largest shift of any category. Top-1 agreement is 0.828, below the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908) and well below fine-tuned (0.900-0.938) and quantized (0.945-0.955). KL is 0.432, TV is 0.173 and the Token-DiFR gap is 0.845; all of these exceed even the system-prompted maxima (0.339, 0.144, 0.52). Sequence agreement is 0.281, near the system-prompted floor of 0.31, and fine-tuned tops out at 0.64. The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.1 fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and the low end of fine-tuned (3.1-10.8). This is a single draw, so values can fall outside the stated ranges. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero, and quantized is ruled out by the large divergence. A strong fine-tune is the main alternative, because it can have a large KL, but the numbers sit closer to the system-prompted pattern.
